purpose: B Backbone과 원래 출력·시간 head를 유지하고 raw 수량 보조항의 batch gradient 크기 제한이 구간별 손익을 개선하는지 비교한다.

alternatives.name: smaller_constant_raw_coefficient
alternatives.reason: 초기 계수 축소와 학습 중 gradient 제한을 이번 세 조건만으로 분리 입증하지 않는다. 적응적 규칙 자체의 우월성 주장은 하지 않는다.

alternatives.name: per_parameter_group_limits
alternatives.reason: 그룹마다 다른 계수는 raw gradient 방향까지 바꾸고, 최소 그룹 계수를 공통 적용하면 작은 한 그룹이 전체 raw 기여를 차단한다.

choice.ratio_rationale: raw 보조 gradient가 기존 joint 기준 gradient보다 크지 않게 한다는 직접적인 크기 기준. validation 또는 저장 train 재생 결과로 rho를 탐색하지 않는다.

losses.L_time: mean original legacy clamped time loss, intercept cap300
losses.alpha_and_raw_scale_policy: Reuse original train-only frozen coefficient receipt; verify identity without fitting validation or using later probe weights to recalibrate alpha.
losses.output: Original log-softplus plus expm1 mapping, no new head, link, bias or quantity-bin weights

control.parameter_universe: ordered unique model named_parameters with requires_grad; include encoder, quantity_head, time_head; unused entries zero for norm calculations only
control.norm: Euclidean norm of concatenated parameter gradients, accumulated in float64 on the current device
control.zero_base: s=0 when base_norm==0 and raw_norm>0; do not add a base floor or moving average
control.nonfinite: fail before optimizer step if component loss, component gradient, norm, multiplier, combined gradient or metric is nonfinite
control.norm_bound: norm(s*g_raw) <= cap_ratio*norm(g_base), within declared numeric tolerance
control.base_cancellation: Time and log gradient cancellation can make the reference small and strongly suppress raw. Record cancellation diagnostics; do not claim either task gradient is individually protected.

statistics.initialization_policy: use original frozen B mu/std after verifying recalculation; no refitted replacement

initialization_and_exposure.fairness: Equal data exposure and optimizer steps; additional gradient measurements make this unequal compute. Log measured wall time, memory and autograd work; do not claim same compute.

candidate_order: one original causal forward; form mean L_base and alpha-weighted L_raw from the same graph
autograd.grad(L_raw, same active_params, retain_graph=True, create_graph=False, allow_unused=True)
compute detached scalar s from finite component gradients; release extra vector references after scalar diagnostics
backward(L_base + s.detach()*L_raw), preserving existing None-vs-zero .grad semantics
finite gradient check then the unchanged global clip_grad_norm_(all model parameters,max_norm=1)
backward_contract.no_extra_forward_or_rng_consumption: Gradient measurement must not rerun forward, consume RNG, mutate recurrent/memory context or write .grad. Check on actual model before GPU launch.
backward_contract.inactive_parameters: Unused/inactive head .grad must remain None for AdamW compatibility; norm-only zero materialization is not an assignment to parameter.grad.

global_clipping.application: existing common clip_grad_norm_ across all model parameters after composition; one subsequent original AdamW step

backward_contract.global_clip_semantics: Apply existing clip only after composition. Preclip time/log coefficients remain1; common clipping and AdamW can change actual time/log parameter updates. No learning-rate-preservation claim.

evaluation.adaptive_training_loss_on_validation: undefined; do not synthesize s from validation. Log the uncapped reference loss separately, not as the adaptive training objective.
evaluation.primary_selector: strict earliest minimum validation raw_quantity_rmse over120 epochs
evaluation.secondary_selector: strict earliest minimum legacy_clamped_time_loss; retained for identity, not substituted into quality gate
evaluation.comparison_rules: Each primary state is its own raw-RMSE selected epoch; last120 is the equal-step comparison. Report all metrics from the same checkpoint within each scope; never combine two J selectors.
evaluation.legacy_time_meaning: original clamped loss, not normalized Time NLL

partitions.threshold_source: existing whole-train frozen boundaries, unchanged after viewing validation
partitions.SSE_accounting: Each partition independently sums to overall count/SSE/absolute error. Quantity/history/cross partitions overlap; do not add them together. DeltaSSE/N is additive MSE, not RMSE.
partitions.sparse_cross_cells: Report every cell, including zero and small counts. No cell-specific controller or data-fitted thresholds; cross-cell relative ratios are descriptive, not individual pass gates.

acceptance.baseline: fresh B from same runtime/initialization/exposure contract
acceptance.inheritance: Retain all existing Intermittent quality gates; add all five quantity-bin RMSE and MAE gates in both scopes. Do not import three-dataset candidate selection logic.
acceptance.both_scopes_time: candidate <= B + 0.01*max(1,abs(B)) + 1e-7 at corresponding raw-selected orlast120 state
acceptance.rule: All required gates must pass. Reduced clipping alone never passes the candidate.
acceptance.comparison_with_uncapped_mixed: Report same-scope global and all partition deltas; improvement over uncapped mixed does not replace B gates.

benefit_classification.gate_pass_only: eligible for follow-up, not evidence of benefit or superiority
benefit_classification.strict_primary_rmse_gain: candidate_RMSE < B_RMSE - 1e-7, report absolute and relative size; not statistical significance
benefit_classification.tradeoff: any required MAE/time/stability gate failure prevents promotion even with lower RMSE

acceptance.quantity_bin_rmse_gate: Require same positive n and finite nonnegative SSE. sqrt(candidate_SSE/n) <= 1.01*sqrt(B_SSE/n)+1e-7. Exact SSE equivalent is candidate_SSE <= n*(1.01*sqrt(B_SSE/n)+1e-7)**2; do not add RMSE tolerance directly to SSE.
acceptance.strictness: Deliberately strict engineering bound on harm in each of five prespecified train-defined quantity bins. Not statistical noninferiority, an optimal tradeoff, or a significance threshold. Failure remains a tradeoff result; do not relax gates after observing candidate results.

required_train_diagnostics.each_epoch: sample-weighted s/alpha summaries and norms; unweighted batch clip/rate counts separately, min/max, nonfinite count, wall time and peak memory
required_train_diagnostics.controlled_probe: If a later execution contract includes train-only gradient audits, keep original fixed8192 identities and existing q/history bins. Additional component/group autograd work and checkpoint evaluations must be budgeted explicitly.
required_train_diagnostics.components_and_groups: In qualification or approved bounded probes record time/log norm, time-log cosine, base/(time_norm+log_norm), encoder/quantity_head/time_head raw/base ratios before/after same global s. Do not claim per-group guarantee.

historical_base.identity_authority: content-addressed 70-file frozen import closure, including originally uncommitted code

required_pre_execution_checks: actual frozen B and uncapped mixed gradients and one-step optimizer equivalence with controller disabled
same causal forward, target/padding invariance, no extra RNG/memory state mutation from component probes
detached controller gradient composition and raw norm bound, including zero/nonfinite/unused parameters
same init/batch/dropout/step exposure and no early stop
strict earliest tie for both selectors; full-vs-split resume restores model/optimizer/RNG/selectors and rejects any controller/source identity mismatch
validation metrics and six replay outputs preserve split and selector identity; no validation gradient for s
extend evaluator to five quantity bins plus all15 quantity/history cells; verify additive errors and under/over accounting
new source hash, measured CUDA overhead/memory, finite resource/time ceilings and explicit execution approval
interpretation_limits: Existing train summary arithmetic is a same-checkpoint diagnostic, not the future capped trajectory or validation result.
The global bound is neither a per-example nor a per-group bound, and does not remove raw outliers from a batch.
Norm limiting does not project away conflicting gradient directions and is not a guarantee of AdamW descent or validation improvement.
Changing s also changes average raw weight; these three arms do not isolate adaptive limiting versus a suitably smaller constant coefficient.
Previously inspected seed42 validation remains exploratory. No held-out or benchmark superiority claim.

output_policy.machine_evidence: small JSON and local Python verification only

implementation_map.training_only_insertion: paper/scripts/quantity_comparison_engine.py after single batch objective and before metric accumulation/backward
implementation_map.preserve_common_objective: paper/scripts/mixed_quantity_objective.py is also used under validation no_grad; do not unconditionally compute gradient controls there
implementation_map.condition_and_identity: new experimental condition/controller specification in engine contract, source closure and resume identity; existing B and uncapped paths retain original operations
implementation_map.diagnostic_extra_cost: The original runner already has bounded diagnostic autograd calls on selected batches; the execution budget must count those in addition to 2 new component queries, not replace their count implicitly.

local_verification.scope: Design mathematics, frozen metadata and recorded train gradient arithmetic only; does not qualify the actual runner or authorize execution.
